ul.li: Using Foveros Packaging Technology (3D face-face chip stacking).
Four top active dice on package (C, HUB, PCD, GCD), one passive interposer (Base) and two passive silicon (P)
Top surface of all die/mold are coplanar, treat as monolithic die for TIM assessment.
Metal stiffener is placed around substrate perimeter. Stiffener is shorter than die stack.
Processor Base Power (PBP)=25W
PL1=25W (or any power 10-45W) can be configured in BIOS for NVL 8C as in Section 2.2
PL2 values can be referenced in the Nova Lake H Platform Design Guide (#855310)
